# GraniteBridge Exports

> A professional Indian granite export company supplying premium natural stone — slabs, tiles, cut-to-size, and finished monuments — to importers, distributors, developers, and construction companies across Europe and the Middle East.

GraniteBridge Exports Pvt Ltd is not a broker or marketplace. We procure granite directly from trusted Indian quarries, run quality inspections, handle export documentation, supervise container loading, and coordinate international shipping.
